entities.summary: Lucas Riva Amarante "Bebê" Nogueira is a Brazilian former professional basketball player. He was selected in the first round of the 2013 NBA draft by the Boston Celtics, but ultimately made his NBA debut with the Toronto Raptors in 2014.
